title: KR1: discovery toward a complete structural bijection
objective: Construct explicit weight-preserving mutually inverse residue-to-gap algorithms with universal proofs; investigate at most two mechanisms, preserving partial results without declaring completion.
deliverables: Two mechanism records, exploratory observations and evidence-based selection
Frozen proposals and two separate critic reviews with author revisions
Executable restricted or complete maps with actual proof obligations and exact falsifiers
Source-bound execution and learning records, preserving the unchanged end-to-end objective
success_criteria: Complete success means explicit residue-to-gap maps at every natural weight, universal validity/weight/termination/inverse proofs and separate semantic review
A bridge or restricted theorem is progress, never completion; endpoints must be executable and verified before full-bijection claims
Novelty remains unverified until closest primary constructions are inspected and compared
Exploration may guide invention; rank matching, enumeration and hidden lookups cannot define the map
Engineering checks pass and all capped/unresolved/negative results remain visible
stop_conditions: Hard deadline 2026-10-24T13:02:35Z, from start 2026-10-24T10:02:35Z; all coordination, source inspection and computation counted
At most two mechanisms, two review rounds, two profiles and 16 dispatch proxy units; no nested agents or providers
Ten cumulative enumeration minutes, 2 GiB computational RSS, 1 GiB incremental artifacts, 5 GiB free-space safeguard
No dependencies, paid adapters, deletions, publishing or pushing
Preferred quartic work/quadratic auxiliary space do not define mathematical correctness; record actual bounds and required contract revision if exceeded
No general harness redesign or success-criterion changes after seeing results
